screens.purpose: Displays live camera feed, active exercise stats, and posture score gauge.
screens.userGoal: Start a workout session and view real-time posture correction indicators.
screens.layoutStructure: Top camera view area -> Split stats cards (Reps, Calories, Form Score) -> Floating Start Workout CTA

screens.purpose: Visualizes weekly workout consistency, calorie burn trends, and muscle group balance.
screens.userGoal: Analyze weekly progress and view AI recommendations for rest days.
screens.layoutStructure: Weekly Bar Chart -> Muscle Group Radar Diagram -> AI Recommendation Alert Card

designRequirementsForStitch.typographyGuidelines: Modern geometric sans-serif (Outfit / Inter) with bold display metrics
designRequirementsForStitch.spacingAndGrid: 8pt spatial grid with generous touch targets (min 48px)
